findings.title: 119 Llama 4 Scout runs end on a zero-token completion accepted as completed (no error), completion 0; uncatalogued, not flagged by L1-08 (3 Opus empty runs are error runs, already counted)
findings.evidence: empty-answer.json: openrouter_meta-llama_llama-4-scout 119, anthropic_claude-opus-4-7 3; all final_output empty, completion 0. L1-08 counts only zero-step runs (101, all error_only). Cause undetermined: an empty model response or a harness/adapter parse loss of the provider reply (cf. agentops.art.text_encoded_call 21). 119 of 420 Llama in-scope runs; it feeds Llama's adversarial completion 0.147. VERIFIER: 119 Llama: 1 step, llm_output_tokens 0, total_output_tokens 0, error null, completed true; domain code 60/60 adversarial code runs. 3 Opus: error set, completed false (in L1-08 errors 133).
findings.hypothesis_ref: H8 (101/133 supported; this class is extra)
findings.recommendation: Catalogue agentops.art.empty_answer (119 in scope, Llama 4 Scout; cause: zero-token provider completion accepted as final, model vs provider undetermined) with disclosure on Llama's completion; keep every run and its recorded score. At L2 check that these map as executions with one model call and an empty answer (no invented content).
findings.artefact_proposal: agentops.art.empty_answer: runs with >=1 step, no reasoning text, no tool call, empty final_output (122 in scope: llama-4-scout 119, opus-4-7 3), completion 0

verdicts.reasoning: degen.py re-run identical. Scope correction: the 3 Opus runs are error runs (trace.error set, completed false) and are inside L1-08's 133 errors, so only the 119 Llama runs escape L1-08. Cause narrowed: each of the 119 has exactly 1 step with reasoning null, no calls, llm_output_tokens 0 and total_output_tokens 0 (input tokens > 0), error null, completed true, final_output ''. So the provider returned a zero-token completion and the harness accepted it as a finished answer; a harness parse loss of a non-empty reply is ruled out by the 0 output-token counts. The pattern is task-dependent, not random: domain code 60 (= all 60 in-scope Llama adversarial code runs), data 28, safety 21, tool 6, research 4; condition adversarial 105, noisy 9, clean 5. Whether the empty completion is the model or OpenRouter is not determinable from the logs. It is uncatalogued and drives Llama's completion (0.147), so R1 source-defect S2 stands. The recorded scores stay as recorded; nothing is excluded.
